content.snl:
list-partial(
  Type.annotation(@K, Type),
  Type.annotation(@$+_K$, Type.to(K, Type.to(K, K))),
  Type.annotation(@$\cdot_K$, Type.to(K, Type.to(K, K))),
  Algebra.Field(K, $+_K$, $\cdot_K$),
  Type.annotation(@V, Type),
  Type.annotation(@$+$, Type.to(V, Type.to(V, V))),
  Type.annotation(@$\cdot$, Type.to(K, Type.to(V, V)))
)

values.zh-CN: 约定 K 为域，V 为类型，+ : V → V → V，· : K → V → V。
values.en: Fix a field K, a type V, addition + : V → V → V, and scalar multiplication · : K → V → V.
